gallery.title: File:Mada'in Saleh Al-Hijr Hegra (مدائن صالح) (8136618664).jpg
gallery.description:
Mada'in Saleh, also called Al-Hijr or Hegra is an archaeological site located in the Al-Ula sector, within the Al Madinah Region of Saudi Arabia. A majority of the vestiges date from the Nabatean kingdom (1st century CE). The site constitutes the kingdom's southernmost and largest settlement after Petra, its capital. Traces of Lihyanite and Roman occupation before and after the Nabatean rule, respectively, can also be found in situ, while accounts from the Qur’an tell of an earlier settlement of the area by the tribe of Thamud in the 3rd millennium BC.
According to the central Islamic text, the Thamudis, who would carve out homes in the mountains, were punished by Allah for their persistent practice of idol worship and for conspiring to kill she-camel (as mentioned in the Qur'an), the non-believers being struck by an earthquake and lightning blasts. Thus, the site has earned a reputation down to contemporary times as a cursed place— an image which the national government is attempting to overcome as it seeks to develop Mada'in Saleh, officially protected as an archaeological site since 1972, for its tourism potential.

In 2008, for its well-preserved remains from late antiquity, especially the 131 rock-cut monumental tombs, with their elaborately ornamented façades, of the Nabatean kingdom,UNESCO proclaimed Mada'in Saleh as a site of patrimony, becoming Saudi Arabia's first World Heritage Site.

gallery.description:
Madaan-saleh
Al-Hajar or Madain Saleh, an archaeological site in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia is located in the province of Al-Ola of the Medina, and occupies a strategic location on the road linking the south of the Arabian Peninsula in Mesopotamia and the Levant and Egypt, and the stone name of Diyar Thamud in the valley of villages between Medina and Tabuk, : The stone was known as Madain Saleh or Saleh villages. The stone is located 22 km north-east of the city of Al-Ula at latitude 4726 north and longitude 5337 east. The stone has been used since ancient times. The stone derives its historical fame from its location on the ancient trade road linking the southern Arabian Peninsula and the Levant. By the people of Thamud who came to the Qur'an by mentioning that they had suppressed the invitation of the Prophet of Allah, and then they turned away from their religion, and disobeyed the camel that Allah sent to them.
The site of the archaeological stone (Madain Saleh) in Saudi Arabia, the first site listed on the World Heritage List. In the past it was called the chamber, the largest site of Nabataean civilization south of Petra in Jordan. It has large, well-preserved tombs, with decorative facades dating back to the 1st century BC until the first century AD. The site is located 500 km south-east of Petra, and includes about 50 engravings from the Nabataean era and a number of caves. The stone site bears a unique testimony of the Nabatean civilization. Its 111 huge tombs (94 of which are decorated) and its aqueducts are exceptional examples of Nabataean architectural achievements and hydrological expertise
The effects of Madain Saleh in the province of Ola, located 300 km north of Medina and 400 west of the city of Hail, one of the most important archaeological sites in the Kingdom, but considered by a number of archaeologists are the most important effects of the entire Arabian Peninsula and includes the effects of Madain Saleh 153 rocky interface carved rock also includes a number of Islamic monuments From the castles and remains of the Hijaz railway line and locomotives and extends for a distance of 13 km and the archaeologists call the open museum in what tourists call the "forgotten treasure of the desert" where foreign tourists are surprised by the lack of tourist interest in these great monuments, Mada'in Saleh, the title of the miracle of the mountains is really a miracle, these great palaces carved in the mountains could be carved thousands of years ago without machinery and equipment and from these mountains, God brought to the people of Thamud great camel and stone is located in the name mentioned in the Koran or Madain Saleh, It is called in this age 20 km from the province of Ola and mentioned in the Koran in the name of stone, which is the land of Thamud, the Prophet of God peace be upon him and the Thamudites are the first to inhabit the stone and the first to carve houses in the rocks followed by the Nabataeans. God Almighty reminds us in the Holy Quran in more than the story of the people of Thamud, where God Almighty gave the Almohadians power and were carved out of the mountains homes and sent them to God Almighty Prophet peace be upon them and called them to worship God alone and left the worship of idols but did not believe in him and continued The Prophet of Allah calls upon them to worship God Almighty and said to him, We will not believe you until you come to us with great miracle.
They asked the Prophet of Allaah (peace and blessings of Allaah be upon him) to come out of a large rock with a very large garment. The Prophet of Allaah (peace and blessings of Allaah be upon him) said to them: "If you come with this miracle, do you believe in Allah?" They said: "Certainly." He called on the Prophet of Allah This great camel and God responded to the favor of peace be upon him and drove them out of the rock a very large camel but did not believe in the favor of peace be upon him only a few of the people of Thamud and the rest remained in the worship of idols and the camel drank the water of the well all day and water the next day all the inhabitants of the stone After a period of time, Thamud decided to kill this camel A kill her when they killed the camel decimated God Almighty Bachihh all survived only a prophet of God in favor of peace be upon him and secure with him and departed in favor of peace be upon him and tended believers to Mecca.
Stone and Nabataean:
After the destruction of God Almighty Thamud people remained stone abandoned for many centuries until the Nabataeans are Arabs from the south of the Arabian Peninsula in the first century BC and settled the stone and made it the capital of the South where the capital of the northern Nabataeans is Petra in Jordan The Nabataeans had a very large civilization and built tombs In the mountains and added a lot of the aesthetics of the old building and the Nabataeans continued to flourish and expand in stone until they control the trade routes in the ancient world and the old trade route comes from the south of the Arabian Peninsula until it reaches the stone and the stone is divided into two roads, Petra and Egypt and the Levant, while the other goes to Taima and then destroyed in Iraq. Thus, the stone was a major center for the ways of the ancient caravans and controlled the routes of convoys and reached their influence as historians mention east and south of the Arabian Peninsula. When the Romans feared their influence and their state of this new kingdom, The Romans succeeded in defeating the Nabataeans in the stone in 106 AD, but they did not settle in the stone, but they destroyed the Nabataeans and returned to Syria. Thus the Nabataean civilization was destroyed in the stone and there is no mention of them in history, and the stone remained abandoned for a long time.
The Prophet Muhammad (peace and blessings of Allaah be upon him) passed by the stone (Madain Saleh) in the ninth year of migration during his journey to invade Tabuk and the Prophet landed in stone. The companions came from the wells where the Thamud people drank. The Prophet (peace and blessings of Allaah be upon him) ordered them to pour water because they were wells of people. He said: "Do not enter into the houses of those who wronged themselves except in Pakin. In the hadeeth," If you do not become a pakin, then you should be afraid that they will hit you. "Many scholars are of the opinion that the visit of Mada'in Saleh is for the phrase and the sermon Of these people whom God gave them the ability to While the mountains and the large flock of these large mountains, however, disobeyed and see the scholars of the inadmissibility of eating and drinking inside the houses of the houses of Thamood while there is nothing wrong with eating in the Islamic region in the stone, which is located by the Islamic fortress and railway station Hijaz, where the Prophet Peace be upon him after he left the homes of Thamood has visited the stone many sheikhs and scholars in our time of the past and the sermon of the previous peoples.

According to archeology, the city of the stone was inhabited by the Almohadists in the third millennium BC, and after that they were settled by the Levites in the ninth century BC. In the second century BC, the Nabataeans conquered the city of Al-Hajar, and they overthrew the state of Bani Lahyan and took houses Stone temples and tombs, the Nabataeans have built a stone town for themselves in the inscriptions found. But the city of stone contains a huge amount of inscriptions and animal and the need to study symbols and decomposition, and the areas of Ola and worms and the ruins of life and the oldest may be back to 1700 BC. According to writings, part of which was destroyed by an earthquake, but the city of stone is the effects of the first merchants and traders Coming from southern Arabia. In 2008, the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) announced that Mada'in Saleh is a world heritage site, thus becoming the first site in Saudi Arabia to join the World Heritage List.
